results.problem: Maxwell eigenproblem in 3D photonic crystals with anisotropic media
results.quote: By using 3D discrete Fourier transform (DFT), we design matrix-free discrete differential operators, reducing the per-iteration cost of the eigensolver to a single 3D global DFT.
